benefits.text:
BBIA Last Contour Pen Eyeliner is designed with ultra-fine, soft bristles and Ink Tank technology, helping create precise lines in just one stroke.
The light milky brown shade creates a plump, rounded aegyo-sal effect, helping the eyes look more sparkling. 
Water-resistant, smudge-resistant technology, suitable even for oily eyelids.

howToUse.text:
Make sure the skin around the eyes is clean and dry before use.
Draw a light line along the aegyo-sal area to create a plump, rounded effect.
You can use the pen to add accents or emphasize the aegyo-sal area as desired.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: Ultra-fine aegyo-sal liner pen in light milky brown that helps create a natural, precise aegyo-sal outline.

sellingPoints.text: Ultra-fine, soft tip; Ink Tank technology for precise lines; water-resistant and smudge-resistant.

texture.text: Liquid liner pen with an ultra-fine, soft bristle tip.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it actually makes eyes bigger or creates real aegyo-sal. “Plump, rounded/sparkling” is only a makeup effect.
